examples.text: 喺香港生活我哋都尚算開心嘅。
examples.jyutping: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sang1 wut6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 soeng6 syun3 hoi1 sam1 ge3.
examples.translation: It is fairly happy to live in Hong Kong.

senses.definition: 加強語氣表示數量多 (used to emphasise a large number of something)
senses.label: 介詞

examples.text: 每日都有數以千計嘅人經過呢條街。
examples.jyutping: mui5 jat6 dou1 jau5 sou3 ji5 cin1 gai3 ge3 jan4 ging1 gwo3 ni1 tiu4 gaai1
examples.translation: There are thousands of people passing through this street every day.

senses.definition: 計數起草用嘅紙（量詞：張） (rough paper for calculation)
senses.label: 名詞

examples.text: 監考員會收走埋考生嘅算草紙。
examples.jyutping: gaam1 haau2 jyun4 wui5 sau1 zau2 maai4 haau2 sang1 ge3 syun3 cou2 zi2.
examples.translation: Examiners will also collect rough paper from candidates.

senses.definition: 比喻人#攰 到極點，骨架散開咁滯 (exhausted; very tired)
senses.label: 形容詞

examples.text: 今日行咗六個鐘山，個人攰到散晒。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 haang4 zo2 luk6 go3 zung1 saan1, go3 jan4 gui6 dou3 saan2 saai3.
examples.translation: I took a six-hour hike today, and I am completely exhausted.

senses.definition: 俾#火 燒爛、燒到唔再完整；焚燒毀滅 (to destroy something by burning)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.text: 今次山火燒燬咗一百畝林木。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 saan1 fo2 siu1 wai2 zo2 jat1 baak3 mau5 lam4 muk6.
examples.translation: The fire today burned a hectare of forest.

senses.definition: 衰格或者帶衰一個地方嘅人 (a bad person or a person who brings bad luck)
senses.label: 名詞

examples.text: 佢次次返工都做錯嘢，趕走晒啲客，正一係衰神嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ci3 ci3 faan1 gung1 dou1 zou6 co3 je5, gon2 zau2 saai3 di1 haak3, zing3 jat1 hai6 seoi1 san4 lei4 ge3.
examples.translation: He messes up things every time he comes to work and makes customers freak out. He brings bad luck.

senses.definition: 仔細又精密，多數用嚟形容一個人嘅心思或做事態度 (careful and delicate in one's thinking, mentality or attitude)
senses.label: 形容詞

examples.text: 小惠係個心思細密嘅會計師，十年以來佢一個人睇晒成個集團嘅數都冇出過問題。
examples.jyutping: siu2 wai6 hai6 go3 sam1 si1 sai3 mat6 ge3 wui6 gai3 si1, sap6 nin4 ji5 loi4 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 tai2 saai3 seng4 go3 zaap6 tyun4 ge3 sou3 dou1 mou5 ceot1 gwo3 man6 tai4.
examples.translation: Wendy is an accountant with a delicate mind. She has been overseeing all the accounts in the corporation for ten years without any problem.

senses.definition: 啱啱好完全命中 (just now, it hit the target perfectly.)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.translation: [ChatGPT]This company serves great quality food.

senses.definition: 好快嘅情況下；好快嘅一刻之中 (in a flash; suddenly)
senses.label: 副詞

examples.text: 就喺我分心嘅剎那間，我就#叉錯腳 跌咗落樓梯。

examples.translation: At a moment of distraction, I accidentally made a wrong step and fell down the stairs.

senses.definition: 減輕壓力、撞擊 (to absorb and dissipate force or pressure)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.text: 佢五樓跌落街，多得帆布#簷篷 卸力，執返條命。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ng5 lou2 dit3 lok6 gaai1, do1 dak1 faan4 bou3 jim4 pung4 se3 lik6, zap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.translation: He fell five floors and was fortunately saved by a canvas canopy that cushioned the impact.

senses.definition: #醒目 (smart; clever; perceptive; resourceful)
senses.label: 形容詞

examples.jyutping: sing2 wo3 aa3 joeng2!
examples.translation: You are so smart, Ah Yeung!

senses.definition: #精神；充滿活力 (lively; energetic)

examples.jyutping: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 seon3 sam1 sin1 dak1 maa5! sing2 di1! gei3 zyu6!
examples.translation: You gotta believe in yourself! Liven up! Remember that!

senses.definition: 把守尾關，確保唔會出問題 (to be the last defender in an organisation or in a system)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.text: 有會計守尾門，公司就唔會亂使錢。
examples.jyutping: jau5 wui6 gai3 sau2 mei5 mun4, gung1 si1 zau6 m4 wui5 lyun6 sai2 cin2.
examples.translation: Having an accountant as the last defender, the company will not spend its money arbitrarily.

examples.jyutping: gam1 maan1 caan1 faan6 jau4 joeng4 zi1 gam1 lou6 sau2 mei5 mun4.
examples.translation: The last item in tonight's dinner is mango pomelo sago.

senses.definition: 喺回合制嘅遊戲入面，最後一個行動 (to become the last player in a round-based game)

examples.text: 上鋪你結，家吓我守尾門添。
examples.jyutping: soeng6 pou1 nei5 git3, gaa1 haa5 ngo5 sau2 mei5 mun4 tim1.
examples.translation: You won the last game. Now I'm the last one to play.

examples.translation: to be caught between two conflicting parties with each of which one has a close relationship, literally: the palm is flesh, and the back of the hand is also flesh

senses.definition: 唔使食飯嘅肚，比喻人好捱得餓 (literally, the belly of an immortal, meaning one who can survive without eating for a long while)
senses.label: 名詞

examples.text: 我可以一日裏面淨係食一塊餅乾，朋友都話我個肚係神仙肚。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 jat1 jat6 leoi5 min6 zing6 hai6 sik6 jat1 faai3 beng2 gon1, pang4 jau5 dou1 waa6 ngo5 go3 tou5 hai6 san4 sin1 tou5.
examples.translation: A biscuit can be all I've eaten in one day - my friends said I have a belly that can endure extreme hunger.

jyutping: soeng1 cing2 bat1 jyu4 ngau5 jyu6

senses.definition: 唔好刻意編排，順其自然 (don't artificially arrange things and let things happen naturally; serendipity; by chance)
senses.label: 語句

examples.text: 好多時候無意中識到有相同興趣嘅朋友，真係相請不如偶遇。
examples.jyutping: hou2 do1 si4 hau6 mou4 ji3 zung1 sik1 dou3 jau5 soeng1 tung4 hing3 ceoi3 ge3 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 soeng1 cing2 bat1 jyu4 ngau5 jyu6.
examples.translation: Oftentimes, we become friends with people who have the same interests entirely by chance. Such serendipity!

keywords: soeng1 cing2 bat1 jyu4 ngau5 jyu6
soeng cing bat jyu ngau jyu

senses.definition: 買衫褲之前將佢着上身，睇下大細符唔符合身型、啱唔啱身，着落好唔好睇、襯唔襯 (to try on clothes to see if they fit or match)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.jyutping: si3 san1 sat1
examples.translation: fitting room

senses.definition: 曾經經歷過、做過 (to have ever previously experienced; to have tried; to have been; to have done)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 mei6 si3 gwo3 gam3 zing6.

senses.definition: 將#物件 擺喺一個#隱蔽 嘅地方，#費事 俾人揾到 (to hide something; to keep something concealed)

examples.jyutping: nei5 sau1 maai4 di1 mat1 je5 hai2 hau6 min6 aa3?

examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 me1 dou1 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2.

senses.definition: 生理或者心理上嘅痛楚、缺失 (harm; damage; injury)

examples.jyutping: ci4 dou3 saam1 ci3 wui5 gei3 jat1 go3 siu2 gwo3.

senses.definition: 令法案或計畫產生效力 (to implement; to put a plan or system into practice)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ceot1 nin2 zoeng1 wui5 si1 hang4 cyun4 man4 ji1 liu4 bou2 gin6 zai3 dou6.

senses.definition: #承受#支撐 物體 (to carry; to bear weight; to sustain)
senses.label: 動詞

examples.jyutping: sing4 zoi3 lik6

senses.definition: 好嘅心腸；憐憫人、慈悲嘅心 (benevolence; mercy)

examples.jyutping: coet1 ju1 sin6 sam1
examples.translation: out of one's benevolence
